nom: Peace Out Oil-Absorbing Pore Treatment Strips

avis.texte: These strips are the holy grail for clusters of acne anywhere on you skin. I love not having to use multiple individual dots anymore, this looks way better lol.

avis.titre: Favorite nose strip, effective, little spendy
avis.texte: These are my favorite pore strips hands down. They are spendier than Bioré's and florence by mills's, but they work so well overnight and come with a second patch for another high breakout area. They soak up a LOT of oil and the difference in my nose is super visible. Last night I used the second one on the side of my face where a breakout was and it brought out SO MUCH, much more than a typical pimple patch. Unlike Hero's version, there is also no second, plastic divider between you and the item. Bummer you only get four though. Definitely not cost effective
Slept with the strips on, the results were great in the morning. So easy and useful, will be using regularly.

The 1st time using the Peace Out Pore strips there was a lot of oil lifted from my nose, especially on the sides and near the nostrils. Then when I washed my face later that evening, that's when I really noticed how much it helped pull white heads & black heads to the surface. It only gets better from there.
I absolutely love these! I have tried another brand and they did not compare.

avis.titre: Best large-size hydrocolloid strip on the market!
avis.texte: This is my new favorite hydrocolloid/pimple patch product. These are excellent for getting the T-zone, and both shrinking acne and pores generally. It really does pull out sebum better than other brands. They're expensive, but worth it.
These strips keep my pores almost invisible! Especially on my nose and chin.

These WORK, i have HUGE pores on my nose because I'm Italian and i hate them. Even if I squeeze out everything and wash wash wash. This is the first product that REALLy WORKS to make them smaller and WAY less dark. Thanks, ball out, peace
So impressed with the Pore strips. Haven't used any that have done such a good job!
By far my most guilty pleasure, left my face looking and feeling amazing! And looking at the dirt and oil that was removed is a small reward for a chronic picker like myself!

I love these strips for my nose pores. I like the shape of the patches, it fits the area well. These work great. They clean pores well without stripping or irritating my skin. I use it once a week or 2 weeks.

these strips were decent. they did a ok job at removing impurities and oils from the skin but not a huge difference in my opinion. the reason i'm giving this 3 stars is because when i took them off the adhesive was so sticky it left a red mark on my nose and forehead for 2 days. wouldn't reccomend. gifted by peace out skincare.

normally am hesitant to try pore strips because I haven't had the best experience with them actually working and doing what they say they will, but I am pleasantly surprised with this one. It's easy to put on and take off and it pulled some pesky oil out. It's a win in my book.

these are very similar if not better quality than the mighty patch surface/nose imo! super sticky and stays on the face all night, in the morning i was pleasantly surprised at how good my skin looked and the amount of gunk on the strips! gifted by peace out skincare

these are very similar to the mighty patch surface/nose imo! super sticky and stays on the face all night, in the morning i was pleasantly surprised at how good my skin looked and the amount of gunk on the strips!

This peace out pores is a wonderful product. This has a great grip and I like applying and using this nightly. This instantly clears out the gynk in my pores, and I have gone through multiple boxes of this product. I love it!

These pore strips are so great! My skin feels so much clearer after I use them. They also last me a pretty long time because I love cutting up the rectangular ones and using them on smaller problem areas.

avis.titre: My nose was apparently greasier than I thought
avis.texte: I habe combination skin and my worst pores are so large and visible on my nose. I got these when Ulta was giving acne spot treatment dots to any brand purchase. So I tried it. It did tighten up my chin, which surprised me since I didn't see anything from the mirror. My nose, though - it tightened it way up in a very visible way. Additionally, the amount of gunk visible on both sides of my nose around the base was intense. It was milk white. I considered taking a photo but it was pretty gross. Used it a second time with just as much tigghtened skin in a good way, althoughpulls there was obviously less gunk to pull out. I was bedbound for a year and a half due to illness so these had their work laid out for them, and they succeeced. It also stayed on all night, and I thrash in my sleep a lot. I also have nightmares that cause cold sweats, which happened the second time. They stayed in place, though!
FAVORITE PATCHES SO FAR FROM PEACE OUT! I always buy in bulk. Obsessed.
The no strep pulled a lot out. We cut the other strip and positioned in different places of the face. That one did not pull as much out. We've only used them once so far.
These are unbelievable. They pull out stuff that I had no idea was in my skin. Great purchase!

Peace out pores! Amazing for my nose area! My pores are enlarged & annoying in this area. What a difference my nose appears the next day! I use these when I have an event to attend or want to look my best.

I love these strips, they are a staple in my skin care routine. They help minimize /clean out my pores. I have clogged pores and small bumps mostly on my forehead. Probably after a month or so of using these consistently I started to notice results. I've been using these for over a year now and love them! Thank you peace out skincare!

I typically use the long strips for my chin area and it's so helpful when I have a flare-up of multiple pimples. I love seeing everything that comes out overnight. I wish they sold those solo, without the nose strips. Sometimes I'll breakout on the edge of where the nose strips end after using them.
I really love this pore strips. They really do make big pores, smooth and small looking.
These really clean out my pores like no other! Love the reaults!
5 stars . Immediately had improvent in skin look. Feeling was a bit sticky after use but a 2nd cleans makes it perfect
It's so fun using these products. And the results when you take it off is amazing ! Your pores will look smaller for every try

I bought this after seeing the many "good" reviews about it working wonders to suck up the gunk from the pores, but that was clearly a mistake. This did absolutely nothing, no gunk was on the tape after 6 hours. You're paying so much for something that is no different from an ordinary tape.

Ohhhkay. So these will 100% rip out your face fuzz. It hurts so much. I used one box over the course of two weeks, and while they maybe made my pores a bit clearer, it wasn't worth the damage they were surely doing to my skin. I couldn't see any debris on the used strips - only fuzz :'(
They worked amazing! They took out all my pores! I absolutely loved them! I use them whenever I see my pores! There are very easy to work with!
This product truly has the stickiness to stay on all night and pull out the blackheads and congestion on my nose. Very pliable material makes it easy to contour to the nose.

I have used this product two times. I just couldn't believe, how much good they did for my skin. My T area and nose, it's so smooth and the pores look so small and clean. I actually just kept looking in the mirror in a smile. This company really has very good products.
It really does the job. It's the best pore strip I ever tried.

avis.titre: My favorite of the Peace Out products
avis.texte: I use these all over my face. I love that I can cover larger areas and tear to fit the area I want. They are just as effective as the smaller patches at eliminating oil and pimples.
I am satisfied with the results of the Peace Out pore strips , and like to use them while I sleep for the next day. Would buy again.

avis.titre: Very good, been using for about a year.
avis.texte: It gets a lot of gunk out if you use it after you take a very warm/hot shower and then dry your nose/whatever part of the face you use it for. Have been using it for almost a year on a weekly basis and my pores are definitely a lot clearer.

I have only used the strips twice so far. One nose strip and one regular pore strip on my chin where blackheads are the worst for me. I noticed more came out on nose strip. I think the one I put on my chin needed to be cut so that was my fault. Everything wasn't extracted but that's not what I was expecting. I will say the surface area did feel smoother. Will definitely repurchase!
I am completely obsessed with pore strips! These work amazing and have really cleared up my nose! I try not to use them too often, but they are definitely addicting to use!

I love these so much — I use them very often as they are easy to apply and don't leave a sticky residue behind. These are the best patches for pores on the market in my opinion, I usually put them on overnight and take off in the mornings! Gifted by peace out skincare

I have combination skin and congested skin. I initially thought this was like the ones I used to use from the drug store 15 minutes thing but this is different it needs a 3/6 hours on your pores. So I decided to sleep with them on overnight (which you can). It's a satisfying feeing to see the gunk come out. I didn't post a pic because it's not something I want the internet to see eww! Lol

Another slam dunk from Peace Out. These are so much better than other strips I've used. I don't feel like they are pulling the tiny hairs out of my nose like other ones do 😅 I really enjoy their products and these pore strips do just as well as the acne spots and truly remove black beads and white heads.

This pore strip were sent to me for a honest review. I had used them twice and I absolutely love these pore strips! They actually work very well yet gentle to your skin however they are in the pricey end so I'm not sure if I will be able to afford them.

My favorite hydrocolloid patches!! I love that they have actual skincare ingredients built into the products instead of it only being a patch without the ingredients like mighty patch. These really work!!

I got these strips for my husband. He has big pores and blackheads, especially on his nose. These strips are really easy to apply. He had a strip overnight and it did an amazing job lifting away dirt and dead skin cells. You can see everything on the strip! gifted by Peace Out Skincare

Gifted by Peace Out Skincare. I've been able to use these strips twice so far and have enjoyed them thus far. It honestly reminds me of the biore strips that I used to get. This is a good alternative, but not much different than other brands I've used as far as end results go.

I received this product for free, and was blown away by the results. My tea zone gets very oily even though I am super dry on a normal day. I'm also a make up artist so I wear a lot of foundation and products from day today. This makes my pores get yucky and causes blackheads. My pores end up being large and this product really helped! It's a 5 out of 5 for me!

I received Peace Out Pores gifted by Peace Out SKincare in exchange for my honest review. I don't like using normal nose strips so these are a great alternative to those. They soak up any excess sebum and impurities. I also like cutting up the pore strip to cover specific areas of my face. They are thicker so I can only use the pore strip at night with the nose strip.

I like how low profile these are while still being bright and cheery. They stick on my face well and come off without irritating my skin, they also work wonders for treating the acne, big and small. People will see me using them and ask why I am wearing stickers, and when i tell them they are for acne they are excited to try them out themselves

I used one of these for my nose the other day for the first time and I am still grossed out and fascinated about the amount of dirt and oil that came out. After a few hours it left the skin of my nose feeling hydrated, clean and smooth. 10/10!

These were gifted by peace skincare.I have loved this product. This will be an item I will be repurchasing. I have very noticeable pores on my nose. I used this last night before bed time before my skin care routine and i noticed right away how my pores were less noticeable. The strips were easy to remove. If you have issues with your pores and they are noticeable,I definitely recommend these.

I am loving these pore strips! I have combination skin with my nose and chin being oily. Using these has helps clear up those areas so much! It pretty amazing to see the amount of gunk that comes out after using one. My breakouts have been much less and don't last nearly as long when using these!

I don't have a lot of pores, but the ones on my nose area really bothers me ) and recently I got these Oil-Absorbing Pore Treatment Strips from Peace Out Skincare. I apply a the pore strip, tacky-side down, on just cleaned and dried skin and take it out after four hours and here's my Before&After results (pictures attached). Gifted by Peace Out Skincare

avis.titre: A new staple in my weekly routine!
avis.texte: I'm already a huge fan of Peace Out products, so I was so excited to receive these in exchange for my honest review. These do exactly what they say they are going to do. I truly felt after one use that my pores appeared smaller and my skin was clearer. The adhesive is a bit strong, but it gets the job done and they didn't budge while sleeping.

Complimentary from Peace Out Skincare. I used these on both my husband and I and these work the best. They're so easy to apply and very very comfortable once on your nose. We both used these at night and we slept comfortable and in the morning we even forgot we had these on. The nasty that came out was a lot! These work!

I could not believe the transformation i saw on my nose after using this product. It completely removed all my blackheads and my nose never looked more clear. The application process was easy and so was removal. I got this complimentary from Peace Out Skincare.

These pore strips from Peace Out do the job. I'm a fan of hydrocolloid patches and these are no exception. I put one on my nose overnight which absorbed so much oil and reduced the visibility of my sebaceous filaments

avis.titre: I have tried many nose strips and pore strips before as I ha
avis.texte: I have tried many nose strips and pore strips before as I have black heads and big pores. I don't think any of them worked as good as this one. I had it on for 2-3hrs and after removing it-there is clear evidence that dirt was removed and my pores cleared and minimized.

Not sure how I feel about these yet. I've used them about two times and both times I could see something on the patches but I didn't notice much difference in my pores. Skin does feel smother afterwards though, they're very gentle on the skin and they peel of easy. I'm gonna keep using it and see how I really feel about it.

This has come as a holy grail product for me. Love th3 way it applies and doesn't feel sticky on my skin. Within 8 hrs, it removed the gunk from my pores and it decreased in size. I love this. Gifted by Peace Out Skincare.

I recieved this complimentary from peace out for my honest review. These are so satisfying. It's impressive how much junk it can pull out. I would prefer a pack to have all nose. I'd get more use out of the nose strips. They worked great but it felt tight on my nose like it was pulling and felt like the strip was irritating my nose. I only kept it on for a few hours due to that. I may cut them and apply differently to prevent that.

One of my biggest skin concerns is my pores...especially the ones on my nose. These strips are exactly what I've been needing! They stick to my skin well and after wearing one overnight my pores are noticably less clogged and much less noticable! These also come with a rectangular strip in each pack that can be cut/sized to use on any area you need to target! Gifted by Peace Out Skincare

I am in love with this product! I apply this usually overnight on clean skin, and it always pulls out so much gunk from my skin! It's amazing to see the instant overnight gratification. It leaves my skin looking super smooth! I received this product complimentary from Peace Out Skincare.

I use it overnight I feel it works best sense I'm not consistently moving. It didn't leave any residue or leave my skin feeling extra dry. It actually left my t zone feeling soft and hydrated. My pores looked amazing. Noticed a huge difference after two uses

I tried these strips and kept them on for about four hours. I believe the nose strip worked better than the pore strip in the end (I put it on my chin). The strip did not peel off anything visible but there were white bubbles showing where the pores were targeted. The nose strip was also kind of itchy! Overall I would rate this product a 6/10 based on my first time experience.

I tried these strips and kept them on for about four hours. I believe the nose strip worked better than the pore strip in the end (I put it on my chin). The strip did not peel off anything visible but there were white bubbles showing where the pores were targeted. Afterwards my nose was very smooth and shiny. It was very effective for before make up situation as it extracts the oils from the area. I will say that the nose strip was also kind of itchy! Overall I would rate this product a 6/10 based on my first time experience.

Gifted by Peace Out skincare! Amazing product for those stubborn pores that don't seem to go away. Great to use once a week before bed. It's satisfying to take it off and see all the dirt/stubborn blemishes that were removed. Great for anyone who needs this product!

avis.titre: My favorite "all over the face" patches!
avis.texte: These are my favorite patches for large use on the face! The nose patches fit perfectly on the nose and you can see the difference in the morning, I don't have huge pores but these patches still seem to get stuff out. I also like the chin patches because they're long rectangles, so I use those on my china and forehead. (gifted by peaceout skincare)

This product is strong! The sticky part is so legit. I keep this on over night and by the morning you can see all the oils it absorb over night. When I pull it off I have a hard time bc of how stuck on it is but definitely removes any black head or stubborn hairs or gunk ! Mainly use it on my nose area!

Gifted by Peace Out Skincare. I was a bit sceptical about this product, since all pore strips I used so far haven't really done much. I tried the pore strip and was satisfied, it removes blackheads and clogs that are on the surface, however they don't help to get rid of blackheads and clogged pores.

Peace out strips are hands down my favorite, in all their varieties. They just work better than other brands in my opinion and these are great for trouble areas like nose, chin, forehead and cheeks to cover a larger area. I find they work best when they're on overnight or for an extended period to really get out all the gunk. I always have a set of these on hand when I get hormonal breakouts during my period and I'll cut the forehead one and use in two pieces on my chin.

I was really excited to try these but sadly was not a fan. Using these caused my skin to get irritated. I do have have sensitive skin so I will definitely think twice about using these if you can relate.

Very different strips. I'm accustomed to the ones you leave on for ten minutes then you painfully rip off. These are comfortable to wear for the recommended 4-6 hours and gently pull away. I find them to be quite effective, my nose looks way less congested and my pores appear smaller because of that. Super product! Gifted by Peace Out Beauty.

Excellent product for minimizing pores and keeping them from getting clogged! The nose strips are great at getting rid of my oily nose due to pores and I find that it strips impurities without drying out my skin!

I received these Peace Out Pores Strips complimentary from Peace Out Skincare to try out in exchange for my honest review. So far I think that these nose strips and pore strips are pretty useful, and I think I have seen a tiny improvement after using these!

The peace out nose/pore strips are awesome! They really get all the under the surface gunk out on bigger areas! The nose one can really get into the curves on my nose to get all of the stuff out unlike the smaller patches.

These have really been helping minimize the large pores on my nose and between my eyebrows. I end up cutting up the shapes to target certain areas. Would be great if you sold them just in the large rectangles so we can easily customize.
I love these strips! They're my essential to my skin care routine. I have such big pores and these always help me feel so much better about them! If you're thinking about it, try these!!

I wanted to like these, really I did, and I had such high hopes. I've used them twice now and I have not seen one difference in my pores and they're is clogged as ever. Whoever's reading this I hope they work for you :)

I bought these for my oily skin and blackheads on my nose and cheek area. I love watching the amount of oil being sucked from my skin. My pores and less clogged and my skin feels significantly better than before! Holy grail!
My nose looked and felt more clear when I woke up. I liked that it was the color of my skin and not white, like other nose strips.
They were like giant pieces of clear duct tape. Have to Ieave on for 6 hours.....ridiculous

I am in love with these pore strips. My nose doesn't look noticeably oily, but boy do these strips extract a lot. (My husband has very greasy skin, and these strips become a Rorschach test when he uses them.) They are comfy to wear and painless to remove. Each foil pack contains a nose strip and a rectangle strip. I have found that I can use both as nose strips (and I don't have a particularly large nose).
Work so good! They absorb all the oil out making pores cleaner and smaller
Love that they are invasive on the skin and suck all the oils and gunk out

These oil absorbing pore strips are amazing. Even though one is intended for your nose, they both are customizable. Whether ypu want to tackle little milia near your eyes or cluster of bumps on larger areas, the results will be the same: clearer skin!

This things are great! I have a combination skin, I use this on my oily areas (nose and chin). Prior to using these I used the basic pore strips but never really saw any significant improvement. Since using Peace Out, I've been getting amazing results. They've really helped prevent any breakouts around my nose and chin, and have been helping to clear my persistent blackheads!
i have very oily skin and it's hard for me to use patches until i found these ones. they absorb the oils rn suck out the gunk all at once and they're just great

These are so easy to use. Life gets busy and sometimes I slack on my skincare and it shows quickly on the nose, forehead and chin pores. I just put these on overnight and they make a huge difference. So glad I found them!

I'm going to preface this by saying I was in a rush so I only left them on for 2 of the recommended 4-6 hours. However I can't see how this would affect it, if anything it seems like less time would make them easier to remove. These hurt so so bad to take off. I tried peeling them off slowly, which was excruciating. I tried going fast like a band-aid but that hurt too. After I managed to get them off my face was bright red for another 30 min and stung. My pores might have improved but I think I ripped off all my face. honestly, not at all worth it.
It really works and happy about the result. I am gonna order them more!
Too sticky. They should only be as sticky as the dots. Great idea but end up causing more irritation.
Great product in my opinion. The nose strip works wonderful and I would highly recommend trying out this item.

avis.titre: I tried it out and I...
avis.texte: I tried it out and I was amazed at how well it worked and how clean my skin felt afterwards.
I was hoping it would reduce my pores more, based on the reviews, didn't see much difference
I used them at night but in the morning they were hard to get off.
These have been great. I wish they both were nose pcs however I actually cute the other one and put in specific areas of need.
Truly only product out there that works and you see results immediately
I've used the nose strips and the other in the chin , acne bumps are smaller and the pores looks much lower and not showing! Thank you
These strips have changed my life!!! They prevent so many cystic breakouts and make it easier to extract pores once I take them off and cleanse with warm water. Safe to say im hooked!
I use on large pores and it definitely helps them reduce in size. Will be ordering again!
